ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx. 90%) with low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels (approx. 10%) localized at the trailing edges, tips, and peduncle interface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous field of white pixels across both lobes; thin dark banding along the superior trailing edge; isolated irregular dark polygon on the mid-lateral section of the left lobe; dark mottled pixel density at the basal insertion point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped indentation with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 72 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (saw-tooth pattern) along the entire trailing edge; notably sharper and more irregular pixel peaks on the right lobe distal section compared to the smoother transition on the left lobe proximal section.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex trajectory extending from the median notch to the distal tips, resulting in a distinct tapered, upwards-swept profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, textured, high-contrast grey/white pixels localized exclusively on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single distinct dark pigmented spot on the ventral surface of the left lobe; extensive textural scarring and apparent barnacle colonization on the distal margins of both fluke tips.
